subject: System Design
title: Database Migration Strategies
description: A 60-second lesson on Database Migration Strategies.

hook.text: Your MySQL database can't scale anymore. You need to migrate to Cassandra. With zero downtime.

buildup.text: The dual-write strategy writes to both old and new databases during migration, then switches reads.

discovery.text: Shadow reads compare results from both databases to verify data consistency before the final switch.

twist.text: Migrations fail when the new database models data differently. Schema translation is the hardest part.

climax.text: Zero-downtime migration takes months of parallel running, careful validation, and a quick rollback plan.

punchline.text: Migrate in parallel, validate in shadow, switch with confidence.

quiz.question: What does the dual-write migration strategy involve?
options: Writing to both old and new databases simultaneously during migration
Stopping the old database and starting the new one
